title: Chapter 6340: Need Not Be Merciless

Chapter 6340: Need Not Be Merciless

Chapter 6340: Need Not Be Merciless

Absolute Ancestor reached a point of not needing to activate her aura to kill. Just her gaze alone sufficed.

The most imperious and prideful emperors could not muster their strength in her presence, Ten-realm included.

Worst of all was the ancient badge in her hand, imposing its will on all subjects. In fact, an emperor wielding a primal weapon still stood no chance against the badge. The weapon’s power and light would be nullified instantly.

“Heavenbreak Badge.” No one could stare at the badge without becoming emotional.

It served as a supreme weapon and a symbol of authority for Desolate Frontier. Rumor has it Desolate Ancestor crafted it for Everlasting Jiang who made great use of it.

When Wisdom Ancestor was in charge of administration, she became the owner of the badge. Later on, she returned it to Everlasting Jiang who eventually passed it down to Jiang Qingmei. The “absolute” in her title originated from the overwhelming might of the badge.

Although she was not officially in charge, her using the badge for this matter meant she recognized Li Qiye’s identity on Desolate Ancestor’s behalf.

Thus, all members prostrated with one exception - Ten-realm who was still screaming and struggling.

His tower became blindingly bright, seemingly on the verge of exploding.

“Kneel.” Absolute Ancestor ordered again.

“Boom!” The tower’s ultimate power was crushed instantly. Next, the tower itself crumbled despite being made from divine metals.

The difference between a primal ancestor and a grand emperor was insurmountable. Access to a primal anima changed everything. Even the weakest primal ancestor could still dominate him.

Weaker cultivators watched in awe while desolate gods and emperors considered this a warning. Their anima power was inferior to the primal stage - the defeat of the greatest genius of their sect made this evident.

Ten-realm struggled to stand up, not willing to be subjected to this humiliation. Unfortunately, he faced the might of her primal anima and the badge.

His bones issued loud cracks. If she added a tiny bit more strength, his skeleton frame would break. The next step would be turning to a bloody mist.

Therefore, the invincible emperor could do nothing but kneel in the direction of Li Qiye who sat there lazily, thinking nothing of this.

This made spectators think more about his power. If he didn’t care about an apex emperor kneeling before him, could he be a supreme overlord?

“Dearest Niece, you need not be so merciless punishing an ignorant junior.” An ancient voice came from the deepest region of Centurial Peak.

An aura of vicissitude engulfed the region, seemingly capable of lifting all of Desolate Frontier. Disciples felt as if they were being lifted from the ground. This applied to Absolute Ancestor’s suppression as well.

She frowned upon seeing this.

“Venerable Ancestor.” Goldclad and Lostmetal became emotional.

All eyes turned toward Centurial Peak.

“Tenth-gen Chen.” Absolute spoke the title of this mythical being wielding a timeless legacy.

Some said he was comparable to Everlasting Jiang in both power and contribution to the sect. Thus, Absolute couldn’t quite contend against him. In all of Desolate Frontier, North Kun God was on the same level but he was preoccupied with the next stage.

“Leave.” Li Qiye who was still relaxing didn’t bother opening his eyes.

He waved his hand and harnessed the power of silence, repelling the ancient power back to Centurial Peak.

Now, even Centurial Peak was subjected to the power of silence.
